notes.title: Patch 0.3.5
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
This week we have new art for the cost region. Accompanied by that, we have a new fishing event, an update to the shop and purchasing card removal,.

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- New battle scene art for the Coast
- New fishing event
- Card removal in the shop no longer charges player to enter card removal screen
- Added a new background to shops

notes.title: Patch 0.3.4.1 HF
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
Small hotfix to address the card/trait/status descriptions clumping up due to the new Godot 4.5 update.

notes.title: Patch 0.3.4
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
This week we have another patch with minor QOL changes. Notably an update to the character select screen, new icons on the map and sfx when button are clicked. Continuing to work on getting the games first trailer together.

[h1][b]Changes:[/b][/h1]
- Fixed a bug with the map environment not saving
- Changed the boss room icons for acts 1, 2 and 3
- Added sfx to most buttons in the game
- Updated the character select screen

notes.title: Patch 0.3.3
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
This weeks brings an update to some UI elements. Primarily, the health and armor bar has had a bit of an overhaul and will now also display damage done to armor and health in different colors to help differentiate when you're taking HP damage. The new underground is also now available as well as a few new UI icons on the map screen.

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- Added a progress bar for armor
- Added new Visual numbers when armor is damage
- Added the amount of logs the player currently has to the top bar
- Added a highlight to the ability button when its available
- Made statuses larger and added a highlight when mousing over them
- Added new underground battle scene
- Updated map icons
- Updated the map camera when first loading the map

notes.title: Patch 0.3.2
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
Another patch filled with UI and QOL updates. Still narrowing in on the final look for the game and hopefully getting the game's first trailer out.

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- Updated battle ability UI
- Added an outline to map icons when moused over
- Added a new mouse cursor
- Added attack title when mousing over enemy intent
- Added a lerping effect to played cards in battle
- Added a lerping effect whenever a card is gained
- Update the route selection screen with a new background that changes based on options presented
- Updated the background art for the map scene
- Updated the transition when the battlefield changes
- Added hazards that can be attacked when the battle transitions to the underground battlefield
- Updated the character selection screen
- Added a new starting node to act 1
- Added a home scene for the first node in act 1

notes.title: Patch 0.3.1 HF
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
Just a small fix to the map scrolling when using directional keys. Mouse wheel is also now available as a scrolling option.

notes.title: Patch 0.3.1
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
This week brings a lot of visual updates to Victory Road. We have the new Steam store art, a revamped grass battle ground and new UI changes. I'm not completely happy with the UI so I'll probably have a few more passes at it. We also now have our first creature intro animation that will play at the start of battle and the functionality can be applied to all other creatures once the animations are in. 
Stay tuned for more updates next week!

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- New Button UI
- New Panel UI
- New Grass Battlefield
- Added updated game logo
- Added ability creature animations to play at the start of a battle
- Updated "Sharp Fang" trait to now have a number indicator and fixed a bug with it not triggering properly
- Added two new traits "Fury" and "Hope"
- Added two new random events
- Added a new background shader to the watch menu
- Added a card flip down animation after playing a card
- Added new sfx when drawing a card
- Updated the indicator above an enemies sprite

notes.title: Patch 0.3.0
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
This week we have a bunch of new cards added in for the transformation options that hadn't been modified last week. We also have a new parallax effect for all battle scenes! A lot more QOL changes have been added.

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- Updated basic battle icons
- Added new parallax effect for all battle scenes
- New shader for transformation scene
- Added new cards "Branch Sweep", "Wave Cutter", "Dam Breaker", "Fixed Gaze", "Log Slam", "Cataclysm", "Overbank", "Agitator", "Apex Fang", "Fang Rush", "Toxic Rain", "Fang Burst", "Searing Strike", "Blight Ward", "Venom Burst", "Blast Rain", 
- Added new status "Glare"

notes.title: Patch 0.2.9.5
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
This week we have a large amount of new cards in the game. Multiple creatures have had their draft deck updated and/or changed with more to come in the next patch. Driplet's starting deck has had multiple new additions added and a new simple strategy based around applying the Exposed status. Apart from new cards, there have been a lot of changes across the game. Many of which are focus on helping explain game mechanics or add accessibility to the current state of the game. More to come next week!

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- Added new card colours
- Added a new label giving a general sense of a creature's playstyle
- Added "Tidepeck", "Terrapede" and "Terravile" to the transformation options
- Added a new card info panel when mousing over the card's element and type
- Added new card element info to enemy intent, enemy element, player's creature, creature's ability
- Map camera will now place itself over the current location on the map when returning to it
- Update the character selection screen
- Added a back button to the character selection screen
- Updated the numbers shown when enemies are damaged
- Added a new way to see your creature's current mood
- Added a card draft after transforming
- Added the following new cards: "Toxic Lunge", "Burrow Bite", "Shed Skin", "Toxic Temper", "Bursting Thorax" , "Burrow Down", "Chitter Step", "Gnaw", "Bubble Burst", "Panic", "Scamper", "Tail Slap", "Splinter Shield", "Surging", "Waterlogged", "Fin Rush", "River Hatch", "Fishling", "Feeding Frenzy", "Unstable Strike", "Tide Buffer", "Torrent Beak"
- Added the following new statuses: "Surge", "Energized", "Swarm"

notes.title: Patch 0.2.9
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
This week, a lot of smaller changes around the game have been added. We now have all the art for the act 1 rivals, we have a rework to transformation and have added a new option! I've added a better look at how the watch menu is going to function. New card art and card flip animations have finally been added and will possibly have a few more updates added later. All that and many other small changes. Next week is going to bring a bunch of new transformation options and random encounters.

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- Added new transformation container
- Updated the watch menu with a new layout and information
- Player data now tracks creatures mood
- Creature description will now update on transformation
- Transformation will now require your current creature's mood to be within a specific range for certain transformations
-  Updated cards to now be able to affect your creature's mood
- Added Act 1 rival art
- A1 rivals now have dialogue after being defeated
- Added "Gritnaw" as a new transformation option
- Added new front and back card UI
- Added a card flip animation
- Added shadows to cards

notes.title: Patch 0.2.8
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
This week I wanted to expand who your rivals were in the game and have them tag along for your journey. All 4 of the unique rivals in Act 1 will now accompany you after they are defeated. You can speak to them at camp and increase their bond level. At max companion bond level, they will grant you of of their cards. Note that their complete dialogue has not been implemented but you'll get a sense of each of them from your conversations in game. I've also simplified rival battles to only include 2 rival creatures to better fit the battle layout and reduce some of their lethality.

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- Added a new companion system to the camping scene
- Camp will now contain all defeated rivals from Act 1
- Added new camp dialogue for Blaze, Burke, Thistle and Marin
- Added companion bond level for all Act 1 companions
- Added ability for unique cards to be grant at max companion bond level
- Added new cards "Combust" and "Venomize"
- Rival battles will now only contain 2 creatures
- Damage adjustment for multiple creatures

[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
Just a small hot-fix to solve the issue with the game closing on launch.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.7
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
This week I focused on adding new status ailments to the game. Creatures can now been seen using new attacks that apply Venom, Scorch and Blast status ailments. If also done the first pass of many aimed that balancing the lethality of certain creatures. Next week I'll be including new player cards that will allow your creature to inflict these ailments also.

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- Added Venom, Scorch and Blast status ailments
- Updated the status text
- Updated status UI location for enemies
- Added new Scorch attack for Pyrote and Infernote
- Added new Venom attack for Gritnaw, Terrapede, Terravile and Octumbra
- Added new blast attack for Furaflare

notes.title: Patch 0.2.6
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
This week some of the creatures in act 3 have been identified (now have their sprites) and seem pretty excited to fight! We also have new rivals who have showed up along the path for acts 1 and 2. I would make sure you're ready before challenging these foes! A few additional QOL changes have also been added this patch. 
Take care and good luck out there challengers!

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- Added creature sprites for Furaflare, Octumbra and Terravile
- Added 3 new act 1 rival battles
- Added 4 new act 2 rival battles
- Added new rival dialogue
- Lowered the default sfx volume
- Changed the location of enemy elements in battles

notes.title: Patch 0.2.5
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
This week, another set of unidentified creatures have begun appearing in act 3. These creatures a powerful so be well prepared! Creatures in act 2 have now been identified and can now be seen in action. A few other small QOL changes have also been included in this patch.

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- Added sprites for Grintusk, Rimetail and Terrapede
- Added 4 new unidentified creature
- Added new battles for act 3
- Updated location of creature names and statuses

notes.title: Patch 0.2.4
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
This week we have a few QOL changes and fixes. Primarily there was a bug with the aqua type battles in act 2 and 3. You should now be able to battle the correct creature in those acts. Hopefully some larger game updates coming next week.

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- Dialogue Overlapping Main Menu Fix
- Fixed bug with act 2 Aqua encounters not spawning the correct creature for the first 3 rooms
- Lowered starting volume of music
- Route Selection will now display the element most likely to spawn in the region

notes.title: Patch 0.2.3
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
Reports are coming in of unknown creatures appearing in act 2 and 3! This week, new creatures have been added to the game however their art isn't finished yet so don't worry if you're seeing temporary sprites in battles. These new creatures are a fair bit more powerful so any feedback on difficulty would be very much appreciated! A few other small tweaks including another reduction of exp earned from early fights have been included in this patch. 
Good luck on your Victory Road journeys!

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- Added 3 new creatures Grintusk, Rimetail and Terrapede
- Added new for act 2
- Added act 2 battles to act 3
- Reduced exp gained in act 1 battles

notes.title: Patch 0.2.2
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
This week I've added a few bits of QOL and a new feature available to events. Events will now be able to have a "Fight" option and has already been enabled for one of the current random events in the game. This will allow for some pretty unique event options in the future. I've also added some much needed updates to the backgrounds of battles. Depending on the region you are in (Bog, Forest, Mountain or Coast), a new background will appear in fights. This will help remind players which region they are in and be a nice change of pace from always seeing the same background from act 1.

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- Event rooms can now have fight options
- Battle rewards from events now include a trait
- Added new trait "Unstable Change"
- The background for battles will now change depending on what region you're currently in
- Added battle backgrounds for the bog, forest, coast and mountain regions
- Adjusted EXP requirements for most transformations
- Reduced gold amount gained from random battles
- Main menu will now appear above everything

notes.title: Patch 0.2.1
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
Another week, another patch. 0.2.1 includes rewards after beating a boss and a guaranteed trait for your creature. An additional 2 new traits have also been added to the pool of options at shops and at sanctuaries. When picking a region, the background for the new map will update based on the region chosen. Finally, the spawn rate of shops has been increased for acts 2 and 3 to give you something to spend all your hard won coins on.

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- Boss battles now have a reward screen after the battle
- Boss rewards now include a trait
- Increased shop spawn chance in Acts 2 and 3
- Map background now changes based on region
- Added the "Scavenger" trait
- Added the "Runestone Shell" trait

notes.title: Patch 0.2.0
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
Patch 0.2.0 is here and a major milestone for the game! This patch includes the long awaited Act 2 AND 3. You will now be able to continue your journey past the first boss and see just how far you can make it in the Victory Road challenge!

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- Added a new UI indicator that tracks your current Act number
- Added Acts 2 and 3 to the gameplay loop
- Added a new trait "Healthy" that can be acquired at the Sanctuary
- Current EXP will now be saved when exiting the game

notes.title: Patch 0.1.9
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]

This week I've added a new route selection scene after a boss fight. You'll have an option between two randomly rolled choices of which region you'd like to move on to for the next acts. These regions will have a higher weighed chance of creatures with specific element types appearing there. You'll want to choose wisely based on what element your creature is. I've also reverted a change to boss rooms. There will once again only be one option at the end out a map 

The next goal will be to implement acts 2 and 3 with regional differences which will influence map generation so... BIG stuff is coming!

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]

- Added a new route selection scene after a boss fight
- Reverted map generation change for amount of boss rooms that appear in a map

notes.title: Patch 0.1.8.5
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]

Another small update this week. In preparation for the multi-act structure of the game, this week's update contains a change to the map structure. There will now be 2 boss rooms that spawn at the end of the path. Next week, I'll hopefully be adding in an additional point behind both boss rooms that will bring you to the indicated region. Region types will only have battles of specific element types. This will be another layer of decision making when it comes to choosing your path.

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- 2 boss rooms will now spawn at the end of the path
- Paths will separate depending on what side of the centre it is and link towards one of the 2 boss rooms

notes.title: Patch 0.1.8
notes.content:
[b][h1]Overview[/h1][/b]
Another small .5 patch this week with a couple changes. I've added a new event to the event pool that is still a work in progress. I've also updated the save system to include saving your current ability number. When you load a saved game, your ability number will now correctly set to your previous amount.

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- Save file now includes current ability number
- Added the "Lonely Guardian" event

notes.title: Patch 0.1.7.5
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
Hello, our first .5 patch this week. Small patch primarily focused around allowing the option to either take or skip receiving a new trait from sanctuary map nodes. A few other minor changes to a variety of things.

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- Nerfed "Sharp Spike" base damage from 10 to 3
- Updated "Quick Think" text to indicated the cards created are 0 cost
- Updated locations in battle of certain enemies to help with visibility
- Decreased the chances Mudmor uses its defence ability
- Changed the amount of current HP healed from a new transformation by half

notes.title: Patch 0.1.7
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
This week, the long awaited "remove card" feature has been added to the shop along with re-rolling card selection. Rumours are saying there is a brand new enemy creature hiding in the tall grass, I think they are calling it "Tidepeck"? A handful of new cards have also been added as well as a balance pass on the starting deck and multiple draft decks.

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- Added card remove option to shop
- Separated the Common + Uncommon from Rare Cards in the Shop
- Common + Uncommon cards are now less expensive on average
- Added re-roll buttons for all card rarities
- Added new creature "Tidepeck" to the battle pool
- Re-balanced various draft decks
- Nerfed Mudmor's HP by 10 (now 65)
- Added new card "Fish Feast"
- Added new card "Fish"
- Added new card "Quick Think"
- Added new card "Pushback"
- Added new card "Tussle"
- Added new card "Yoink"
- Added new card "Bluntclaw"

notes.title: Patch 0.1.6
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
This weeks update adds seeded runs to the game. Card selection, enemy actions, drawn cards etc.. will now be the same if you exit and return to the game during a run. This fixes an issue with last build where players could exit if they didnt get good rng for the current run and load back in to re-roll the rng of the event. I've also added a new enviroment change mechanic that certain cards can trigger or enemies. A new enemy called Gritnaw has also been added.

Next week I'll be focused on adding another enemy and possibly doing an update pass for the shop along with some minor fixes/updates to several systems.

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- Added seeded runs
- Fixed current log amount to save when exiting the game
- Added new card effect to exhaust a random card in hand
- Added new card "Forgetful Leap"
- Added new enemy "Gritnaw"
- Added enemy names above health bar
- Added new ability to certain cards allowing them to change the current environment when used
- Added a new card "Tunnel"
- Tweaked a few creatures draft deck

notes.title: Patch 0.1.5
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]

Patch 0.1.5 is here! Mostly focused on adding a Save/Load system so the continue button will now work when you exit your run. Changed the starter to a new Tier 0 creature and added a new environment for the battle scene. This will temporarily be the default for this patch as I flesh out the new environment changing system for next patch. 

Transforming will now no longer change the starting deck you have, further refinements to the new system will be added next patch. New creatures will also be added next patch, be on the lookout!

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- Added new starter Droplet
- Added creature egg to character selector
- Changed the transform to no longer switch the current deck
- Changed the battle background temporarily until full battle environment transition is added
- Certain cards now create weather effects
- Added a Save/Load system
- Added a button to return to the main menu

notes.title: Patch 0.1.4
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
Patch 0.1.4 is OUT and brings with it a some welcomed updates!
- A new Camping button has been added to the map scene and will be the new default way to rest .
- An Audio Manager has been added to the main menu and in the pause screen during a run. You can now change the volume for the Music and SFX separately.
-  New rivals can been encountered during certain fight!

Next week's update will be primarily focused on getting the continue button up and running with save states for the game. A possible change to evolution may also be included. Stay tuned!

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
- Added a new Camping button on the map screen
- Added a Camping scene as the new default way to rest
- Added new audio for Camping
- Update map generation to have a much lower chance to spawn a rest station
- Rest stations are no longer guaranteed before the boss fight
- Added an Audio Manager 
- Added trainers to certain battles
- Added trainer dialogue before the fight!
- Added new music for trainer battles
- Updated the Shop to now sell logs used for camping
- Added a card fan effect for cards in the player's hand
- Updated card size
- Updated placement of card UI
- Added element images to the intro dialogue
- Slight change to the position of certain creatures in fights

notes.title: Patch 0.1.3
notes.content:
[h1]Overview[/h1]
This patch adds preview buttons for starter and draftable decks for all creatures. A new intro button was added that gives a quick rundown about the game. Also included is a bunch of UI updates to help increase readability.

Next week will be focused on adding trainers to certain battles and hopefully a new tier of creature. 
Stay Tuned!

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
- Added preview button for selected character's starting deck and drafting deck
- Added preview button for all transformation's starting deck and drafting deck
- Added hover texture to deck button
- Updated card selection icon
- Added Feedback button to the Escape Menu
- Changed position of UI elements for character selection
- Added spotlight behind character portrait
- Added outline to trait icons
- Added text outline in multiple places for better readability 
- Adjusted enemy placement during miniboss fight
- Added name in description to multiple traits

- Updated "Swim Slam" damage and text

- Changed map control to move Up and Down with Arrow Up/W and Arrow Down/S
- Added Dialogue Manager
- Added animation when gaining gold
- Updated most scenes to have fade in/out animation
- Added intro dialogue
- Added intro button

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2
notes.content:
[b][h2]Overview[/h2][/b]
This patch focuses on UI improvements for card tooltips and an additional few small tweaks. Next patch will be focused on giving more information when choosing a starting creature and when choosing a transformation. 

As always, feedback is appreciated!

- Updated the Gold icon for the top bar, reward screen and shops

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1
notes.content:
- Added feedback button to main menu and win screen
- Updated Sanctuary icon and scene
- Removed "Blinding Power" trait from Sanctuary pool

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0
notes.content:
Patch notes:
- Reduce Muckmuck attack to 2x3
- Changed the location of debuffs to above hp bar

- Update Flowdams starting/draftable deck
